task: r_intel: what are the 0.955-0.959 teams doing; any public weights/notebook usable now
summary: LB 20:30Z (3,935 teams): we are #217 at 0.954 (40 subs). Band 0.955-0.959 = 136 teams (0.959 14, 0.958 12, 0.957 18, 0.956 36, 0.955 56; ranks 69-204). NOBODY in the band has published the code or weights behind the score: the member scan (16 users via API before a 429 stop, ~35 profiles via the browser, priority to high sub counts and today's movers) found no biohub weights dataset and no biohub notebook newer than x138-era repros. The competition Models tab and Code tab top out at 0.953, and a dataset search for 'biohub' by date shows nothing new since round 11. The only public 'above-x138' engine is still y3uanm's training recipe (teacher-distilled fine-tune of the pilkwang seed314159 secondary). Its notebook OUTPUT IS EMPTY (Output 0 B, a 9.5 s quick-save), so its weights cannot be downloaded; we would have to train them ourselves. Method classes with evidence: (1) x138 plus private own tweaks, including both x138 authors (thtennant 0.959 with 45 subs, anvithpothula 0.956 with 133 subs). Today's jumps straight from exactly 0.953 to 0.955-0.959 (Rasheed 0.953->0.959, Rishabh Roy 0.953->0.957, Freeman Hui and mexlora 0.953->0.955) all carry no public source. (2) Many-submission LB tuning or selection: the band's median sub count is 41-70 vs 25 in the 0.953 block, and 31 band teams have >= 100 subs (zentropy 375, xanderr 293, Matt Goldfield 276, enddl22 227, To The Moon 215). Selecting the maximum over ~50 noisy variants is worth about +0.002-0.003 public with no true gain (variant jitter ~0.001-0.0015). (3) Independent or retrained pipelines. 6 band teams last submitted on or before x138's public date (e.g. Takumu Hata 0.957 with ONE sub on 18 Sep; Umesh Arampath 0.958, last sub 20 Sep), and 15 band teams have <= 12 subs. Forum: Civitasmass retrained the detector; 'detector retraining gave a top-3 team most of the gain'; y3uanm went 0.949 -> 0.956 with the distillation recipe (cause not proven). Counter-evidence for easy knob gains: Justin CH123 (now 0.956) and imissher saw every single-knob PP change lose on the LB, with the loss tracking the node count. HONEST ANSWER to 'why not us': we banned the two things the band does (R7 ladders, R9 retraining), and nothing is public to copy. If the user lifts those rules, two moves are available now: (A) a K2 single-knob ladder with today's 3 slots and the next days' slots (fast; expected +0.001..0.002 public mostly from selection, private ~0); (B) reproducing the y3uanm v1 distilled secondary on Kaggle GPU and swapping it into K2. A secondary swap leaves the V1284 head untouched. (B) is slower (ready ~27 Sep 03-06Z) but is the only evidenced mechanism above x138. Finals policy: keep #37 K2 in every scenario.

items.what: IF the user lifts R9: reproduce the y3uanm v1 teacher-distilled secondary fine-tune (1 epoch, lr 1e-5, freeze all but the last decoder block + heads, BN frozen, loss = softplus at GT + 0.5 BCE to the frozen teacher + 0.1 feature MSE) on a Kaggle T4, then swap it into K2 as the secondary.
items.evidence: The only evidenced mechanism above x138: y3uanm 0.949 -> 0.956 (their v2 adds 10 epochs + non-public synthetic data; the cause of their jump is not proven). Our earlier secondary fine-tune lost (0.937) but had no distillation and was paired with a primary swap. A secondary swap does not touch the V1284 head. Weights are not downloadable (output 0 B), so we must train them.
items.private_risk: Moderate. Trained on all 199 train videos, which cover both train embryos but not the test embryos; distillation to the frozen teacher limits drift. Kill test before submit: a local official-metric check on held-out-by-embryo clips must show no loss vs the original secondary, else do not submit. Never replaces #37; only the #38 twin, only at public >= 0.956.
